column1: # Lamakan: the caravan wakes; Isaac chooses whether to approach, and Mia refuses to let fear decide for them.

column3: Isaac, look. The whole\ncaravan is waking. There\nmust be forty people.{end_wait}
They're moving toward the\nlight. We should keep our\ndistance, Isaac.{end_wait}
And leave them here? I can\nstill hear the Manticore.\nI won't let fear guide us.{end_wait}
No one is being abandoned\nwithout an attempt. Stay\nback while I approach.{end_wait}
They may not understand\nwhat is happening to them.\nKeep your voice calm.{end_wait}
Then I'm going with you.\nI won't watch you walk into\nthat fear alone.{end_wait}
We can't reach them from\nhere. We have to keep\nmoving, even if it hurts.{end_wait}
Isaac... they're calling\nyour name. How could they\npossibly know it?{end_wait}
Don't call them ghosts,\nGaret. Whatever is left\nin them was once human.{end_wait}
I'll take the lead. Not\nbecause I'm unafraid, but\nbecause we must press on.{end_wait}
She kept her eyes ahead.\nI don't think she trusted\nherself to look back.{end_wait}
